title: Developing an interactive mixed-reality product
summary: Built a cross-functional team around a product combining a physical device and immersive digital content.
context: The concept depended on both device interaction and digital content, with delivery work spanning multiple functions.
decisions: I founded the company, coordinated the team and managed investor relationships alongside product development.
outcome: The team secured patent protection for the mixed-reality platform concept. The startup won first place in a Shanghai startup competition.
